about: Real Laminar (lmnr) spans from OpenHands conversations against a scripted OpenAI-compatible model served by record.py itself: no network, no API keys, no rius SDK. Tracing is enabled only by the OTEL_* env vars a user would set; the child process exports OTLP/HTTP to a capture server in record.py, and the captured protobuf spans go through the shared encoder (spans_from_otlp, then scenario_json). lmnr names the resource after sys.argv[0] and ignores OTEL_SERVICE_NAME, and the child runs as record.py, so service.name is record.py. Moved here from the Rius backend's sink testdata, where they were first recorded; the scenarios are unchanged. Only the sink normalizes this family, so the expected result is the row the sink stores.
record: python record.py <recording.json> <environment.json>, in a virtualenv holding exactly the pins below
scrubbing: After the shared encoder (which numbers UUIDs): the workspace temp dir becomes /workspace, other machine paths <path>, object reprs' addresses 0x0, and username/hostname members <username>/<hostname>.
truncation: Every string attribute longer than 160 characters, and every such string inside a JSON-valued attribute, is cut to 160 characters plus a '...<N chars truncated>' marker, the JSON kept valid. The OpenHands system prompt and tool descriptions are several KB each. Truncation runs after scrubbing, so how much of a value survives does not depend on the recording machine's temp-dir path.

lmnr-0.7.64.json.note: First recorded on Python 3.12.13; re-recorded on 3.12.9, as 3.12.13 has no macOS arm64 build. The spans' content is the same. Record with a PATH that has no `python` on it (`env PATH=/usr/bin:/bin <venv>/bin/python record.py ...`): the OpenHands terminal tool records `command -v python` into the spans, so a `python` on PATH changes the existing scenarios.

scenarios.chat_tool_calls: Chat-completions path: the model calls terminal, then finish. Each LLM call is an llm.openai/fake wrapper (cache counts only) with a litellm.completion child carrying the model, usage and messages.
scenarios.llm_error: The model answers 401. The litellm.completion child and the wrapper both end ERROR with an exception event. Matches a real Anthropic auth failure captured with a bad key (same span tree, status and exception types; provider anthropic).
scenarios.responses_api_wrapper_only: api_mode=responses: lmnr does not instrument litellm.responses, so the llm.openai/fake wrapper is the only LLM span and carries only the cache counts. Matches a real gpt-4.1-mini capture, where the wrapper also carries gen_ai.usage.cost (absent here: the fake model has no litellm price).
scenarios.image_base64: The task message carries an ImageContent with a PNG data URL beside the text; the scripted model is not vision-capable.
scenarios.image_https_url: The task message carries an ImageContent with an https URL beside the text; the scripted model is not vision-capable.

lmnr-0.7.64.json.verified: Re-recorded 2026-10-19 twice in a row in the pinned virtualenv: byte-identical. Content (names, attributes, events, status) matches the recordings first made in the Rius backend's sink testdata; only the ids and times, now kept, and the order of event attributes, now sorted, differ.
